hubOrigin.headline: Alibaba’s Big Data Is Helping China’s Exporters Pivot to China

association: The important second-order question is not which exporters can survive weak overseas demand, but which manufacturers have both globally competitive OEM/ODM capacity and a functioning domestic-brand/channel engine, allowing capacity to migrate between markets.

candidate.name: 新宝股份

evidence.claim: H1 revenue +24.78%, attributable profit +79.19%, operating cash flow +34.76%.
Domestic sales +90.87%; Morphy Richards domestic revenue about RMB720m, +240%; Donlim domestic revenue about RMB170m, +70%.
The company explicitly described itself as an export-oriented OEM/ODM leader while elevating domestic brands to strategic importance.

causalBridge: Global supply-chain disruption and home-related demand favor flexible Chinese manufacturers with reliable delivery.
Domestic channel growth reduces dependence on a single overseas demand path.
Shared R&D/manufacturing across OEM and domestic brands can improve capacity utilization and operating leverage.
The company had already demonstrated the domestic-channel engine before the September hub story.

guardrails: Do not use the later 2020 annual report in the selection decision.
Do not infer future Q4 export strength from later data.
The selection must be based only on the hub story plus evidence available by 2020-09-25.
